G1_unambiguity.justification: The modification choices, matrix construction, exponentiation, positivity condition, and required output are all precisely defined.

G2_completeness.justification: It provides the necessary bounds, input format, costs, feasibility guarantee, edge-case behavior, and output specification.

G3_faithfulness.justification: Because the identity diagonal permits any path of length at most n−1 to be padded to length n, the positivity condition in A^n is equivalent to connectivity of all target sites, with the same costs and choices as the original.

G4_naturalness.justification: The statement is coherent and idiomatic, although the matrix formulation is an unnecessarily indirect and somewhat contrived restatement of the cabling problem.
